propositions: recheck-review currently refuses all current-revision finding states, including bugfix-size-attestation blocks even when the ticket carries a valid plan-review attestation
bugfix-size-attestation blocks should be acceptable for recheck-review when the single blocking finding is exactly bugfix-size-attestation and the ticket attestation buckets as accepted
the retrigger eligibility decision must read only the bot's own vote message and ticket store, never trust the requesting comment's claimed criterion or ticket id
a block with multiple findings or an attestation in FLAG_VERDICTS (absent, stale-material, mismatch, invalid) or infra verdict must still refuse
the retrigger path must reuse the gate's own bugfix_size_gate.classify_plan_review_attestation and bucket_for_verdict to avoid drift from the blocking gate
